description: Autonomous agent system infrastructure — core orchestration, execution, memory, runtime, session management, tools, and utilities for building intelligent agents.

subdirectories.name: core
subdirectories.description: Core types, interfaces, and base classes defining the Brain domain contract layer
subdirectories.purpose: Provides fundamental abstractions including agent interfaces, event system, configuration types, error hierarchy, and type registry

subdirectories.name: executions
subdirectories.description: Task execution infrastructure for planning, scheduling, and monitoring agent operations
subdirectories.purpose: Manages execution plans, task scheduling, step execution with retry logic, progress monitoring, and error handling strategies

subdirectories.name: memory
subdirectories.description: Memory subsystem providing short-term working memory and long-term knowledge storage
subdirectories.purpose: Implements working memory, persistent storage, memory indexing, conversation buffers, knowledge graphs, and memory consolidation

subdirectories.name: runtime
subdirectories.description: Execution environment management for safe and efficient agent operation
subdirectories.purpose: Handles process lifecycle, resource monitoring, sandboxed code execution, health checking, and metrics collection

subdirectories.name: session-managements
subdirectories.description: Session lifecycle management for agent state persistence and recovery
subdirectories.purpose: Provides session creation, state persistence, checkpoint management, session isolation, and checkpoint-based recovery

subdirectories.name: tools
subdirectories.description: Extensible tool plugin system for agent interaction with external systems
subdirectories.purpose: Enables dynamic tool registration, safe execution with timeouts, input validation, and standardized result formats

subdirectories.name: utils
subdirectories.description: Common utility functions and helper classes shared across the Brain domain
subdirectories.purpose: Offers structured logging, data serialization, schema validation, timing utilities, and cross-platform path handling
